Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly narrowed the target from the University of Mississippi (where earlier steps correctly identified James Meredith as the first Black student admitted in 1962) to the University of Mississippi School of Law, causing scope drift. This misinterpretation of “where Robert Khayat was educated” led to focusing on the law school and concluding Cleve McDowell (1963), instead of the university-wide answer (James Meredith, 1962).
